The uncharted '''Mytus asteroid belt''' was a thick concentration of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the [[Mytus system/Legends|Mytus system]]. The [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] was situated halfway between the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] primary [[Star/Legends|star]] and [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]], the outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] altered the course of one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the belt to act as cover for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the [[Liberation of Stars' End|liberation]] of [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]].<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>
